title: Keep-alive socket process a response that was written before the request was sent
vulnerabilityInformation: A flaw was discovered in HTTP Agent connection reuse where a client could accept a response that was sent before the request was transmitted. This occurred because the guard that destroys idle keep-alive sockets when unexpected data arrives only ran when the event loop polled for I/O. If an unsolicited response had already reached the socket but was not yet read when the socket was handed to a new request, the guard was removed without detecting the data, causing it to be parsed as the response to the new request. This vulnerability affected multiple versions of a runtime environment.
